answer: Forging a thousand new participants costs the full stake per reputation slot plus a slow trust ramp, while honest long-lived agents earn a rising plume of yield. Colluding clusters get flagged like heat leaking across tundra, since stake-weighted peer attestation from established agents is required before rewards unlock.
